A halftone dot texture overlays the entire pattern, giving it a printed quality reminiscent of graphic design. The motion is generated through time-based calculations that drive color shifts, rotation changes, and the halftone pattern's opacity variations. The entire system operates autonomously using only p5.js core features, creating an endlessly evolving visual abstraction of geometric forms.
